text:
kevin_cs: Hey infra, customer ACME reports a big spike of 503s & 500s for hosted inference since ~09:12 UTC, they're seeing timeouts + increased latency, support ticket #SUP-9921. Sample: `POST /v1/generate -> 503` and streaming sockets drop mid-response. Logs attached in ticket.

nate_oncall: I see the gateway shows upstream 502/503s to infer-runner pool. Alerts for runner restarts at 09:11. Node a3-gpu-17 had repeated container restarts.

maria_eng: can you paste the runner logs? suspecting GPU OOM or segfault from recent quant swap.

kevin_cs: pasted minimal logs from customer timeframe: ```
[09:10:58] infer-runner[pid:24821]: cuda: out of memory when allocating 345MB
[09:11:02] kernel: [oom_killer] Killed process 24821 (runner) total-vm:...kB
[09:11:08] infer-runner: segfault (core dumped) at 0x000000
[09:11:09] kubelet: Container restart liveness probe failed
```

jenna_support: Customer asked for ETA and credits, they have production traffic. Need mitigation steps asap. They've temporarily switched to a smaller model but still see degraded latency.

luis_infra: Quick triage: recent deploy 2026-03-17T08:50 flipped a kernel-level quant path for attn optim. Rolling back that change on a subset would help. Also autoscaler didn't bring spare nodes because binpacking prevented new pods on same AZ.

maria_eng: Repro steps I ran in staging: with large-batch streaming + kv-prefetch enabled, memory growth spikes and then segfault after 60-90s. Repro command: `wrk -t2 -c20 -d60s --script generate.lua http://runner-svc/...` and a sample gdb backtrace shows crash in attention kernel.

nate_oncall: Temporary mitigations: 1) revert quant kernel on hosted cluster canary (rolling crash reduced). 2) set fallback routing to vcpu-compatible variant for affected customers for 1h: `route: fallback: cpu-compat` 3) reduce default max_batch_size from 48 -> 16 for realtime tier.

kevin_cs: Noted. Applied fallback routing for ACME and opened an urgent support note offering 5% credit pending RCA. Customer confirmed 503s dropped but latency still a bit high.

luis_infra: I'll provision two spare GPU nodes in other AZ and adjust scheduler affinity to allow bursting while we stabilize. Also increasing node eviction thresholds to avoid immediate OOM kills.

maria_eng: I'll push a hotfix that disables the new attn kernel selection for production and add a guard: if memory usage > 85% abort kernel swap. Need codeowner approval, pinging @maria_eng.

sre_bot: Incident created INC-2026-0317-01. Pager rotations: nate_oncall, maria_eng. Next: collect core dumps, dmesg, nvcrash logs, and GPU driver logs.

jenna_support: Customer replied: thanks, they see improvement, asked for timeline for permanent fix. I told them RCA + fix ETA in 4-6h.

maria_eng: Action plan: (a) rollback canary + monitor p95/p99 for 30m, (b) run stress test with high-context streaming and validate no segfaults, (c) add automated memory guard + fallback to safe kernel at runtime, (d) postmortem and model-serving regression test.

nate_oncall: I'll monitor host-level restarts and set a short-term autoscaler override to keep 20% spare capacity for the next 6 hours.

kevin_cs: Good. Closed loop: support notified ACME, credits offered, escalation ticket linked to INC-2026-0317-01. Keep this thread updated with timelines and when RCA posted. :thumbsup:
